name: places_pedestrian_visit
about: A use_interesting pedestrian visits an interesting place and comes back for the next (docs/vtmb/npc-ai/programs.md § 'Interesting places: the selector, the programs, the wait'). sm_hub_1's pedestrian_female (npc_VPedestrian, use_interesting 1, interesting_place_groups '1 31') verbatim; the places are the arena's eight intersting_place anchor rows (group_id 0, which CAI_InterestingPlace::Spawn 0x102d9c20 turns into group 1, enabled, max_npcs 1, min_time 4, max_time 12). CAI_BaseNPCTroika::SelectSchedule case 1 step 4 (0x102af6eb..0x102af7f3): use_interesting and no held place -> 0xff SCHED_TROIKA_WALK_TO_INTERESTING_PLACE_SETUP (FIND_INTERESTING_PLACE: eligibility 0x102dad60, pick 0x102db590; SET_PRESERVE_PATH 1; SET_SCHEDULE) -> 0x100 SCHED_TROIKA_WALK_TO_INTERESTING_PLACE (GET_PATH_TO_INTERESTING_PLACE, WALK_PATH, WAIT_FOR_MOVEMENT, STOP_MOVING, FACE_INTEREST, SET_SCHEDULE) -> SCHED_TROIKA_DO_INTEREST_ACTIVITY (SET_PRESERVE_PATH 0, DO_INTEREST_ACTIVITY: ClaimMarker 0x102da7c0 and m_flWaitFinished = curtime + RandomFloat(min_time, max_time) in 0x102a9f40; its run arm 0x102aa210 ends the INTO-IDLE-OUTOF loop, fires OnInterestingPlaceLeft and releases 0x102da600; WAIT_PVS). With the visit released the next selection is 0xff again. No task fails: every place is on the arena floor.
known_red: V4b (N13): the cruise speed is this body's own `walk_0` (101.278 cm/s, the female bank) and is right; the time is lost at arrival -- the body creeps the last ~30 cm for ~4 s before the kernel sees `arrived` (inferred from code until the B integrator toggles it; `packets-R1.md` item 4). pedestrian_female is female_citizen_2.mdl, which includes shared/female/npc_allsequences (the seam agent checked the model's include list; R1 did not run this record). The 20 s bound on the ~1350 cm first leg holds at this body's own speed (1350 / 101.278 = 13.3 s), so no deadline moved
